Title: Clinical Physiotherapist   

  Location: Kingswood , NSW  

  Role: Part time (3 days)  

   

 Are you a passionate physiotherapist seeking a rewarding opportunity in a bustling medical environment? Look no further! We are an established, vibrant private practice, committed to providing extraordinary health care services. 

 We are searching for an enthusiastic, fun, personable, and outgoing Physiotherapist who has a desire to excel in private practice and is ready to make a difference. 

 
	 
	 You should have at least 1 year of proven experience as a private practice Physio in Australia. 
	 
	 
	 You must be dedicated to the ongoing development of clinical knowledge and skills. 
	 
	 
	 You should be eager to take on new and exciting challenges and contribute to team leadership. 
	 
 

   

 Our practice is located within a   busy and vibrant medical center, ensuring a dynamic environment with a steady flow of patients. We offer over 5 years of combined experience working in Musculoskeletal health, disability care, and workplace rehabilitation. 

 We specialize in providing top-notch care to both Workcover and private patients, guaranteeing a diverse and engaging caseload. 

   

  What We Offer  

 Join our team on a  permanent clinic-based Part-Time position (2-3 days per week) , with a clear path for growth: 

 
	 
	  Supportive Environment:  Enjoy a flexible and supportive workplace where your professional growth is nurtured. 
	 
	 
	  Lucrative Compensation:  Attractive salary & commission hybrid system (with the possibility to negotiate a fixed salary or fixed commission if you prefer!). 
	 
	 
	  Ongoing Learning:  Benefit from weekly tutorials to enhance your skills and stay updated with the latest practices. 
	 
	 
	  Development Opportunities:  Receive a  professional development allowance  to invest in your continuous learning. 
	 
	 
	  Full-Time Possibility:  Opportunity to transition into a  full-time role  in 6-12 months. 
	 
 

   

  Skills and Qualifications  

 To be considered for this role, you must meet the following criteria: 

 
	 
	 At least 1 year of experience as a Physiotherapist is required. 
	 
	 
	 Holds a   B.App.Sc.(Phty) or Masters equivalent is required. 
	 
	 
	 Unrestricted AHPRA registration is essential. 
	 
	 
	 Strong networking and interpersonal skills to build rapport with patients, referring doctors, and Specialists. 
	 
	 
	 A good listener who gains understanding of individual patient needs. 
	 
	 
	 Highly Desired: Good time management skills, organization, scheduling, communication, record management, and attention to detail. 
	 
   Apply Now

The Client
Melbourne Earthescapes Pty Ltd is a family-owned earthmoving, landscaping, and construction business based in Ravenhall, VIC, delivering landscaping, retaining wall construction, rockwork, stone installation, and transportation services across Melbourne and surrounding regions. 

They are seeking an experienced Stonemason to join their team in Ravenhall, VIC.

The Role
The Stonemason is responsible for constructing, repairing, and installing stone structures, retaining walls, masonry features, and related stonework in accordance with project specifications and construction requirements.
This is a full-time position with an annual salary of $80,000 to $90,000 plus superannuation. 

The Responsibilities
•	Cut and shape hard and soft stone blocks and masonry slabs to construct and renovate stone structures, kitchen benchtops, and monumental masonry
•	Lay pre-cut stones and masonry blocks in mortar to construct and repair walls, partitions, arches, and structural stone features
•	Study plans and specifications to determine material requirements, dimensions, and installation procedures
•	Erect and dismantle restricted height scaffolding in accordance with workplace safety procedures
•	Seal foundations with damp-resistant materials and apply mortar layers to support masonry installation works
•	Lay stones in rows, designs, and patterns while maintaining structural alignment and finish quality
•	Embed stone blocks in mortar and remove excess material to achieve clean and accurate finishes
•	Check vertical and horizontal alignment of stone structures using levelling and measuring equipment
•	Cut, shape, polish, and finish stone materials using hand tools, polishing equipment, and masonry machinery
•	Repair and maintain stone, brick, and masonry structures in accordance with construction requirements
•	Design, cut, and install monumental masonry and stone lettering works
•	Construct retaining walls, stone facades, and structural masonry installations for residential and commercial projects Choose and prepare appropriate metal materials for fabrication

The Requirements
•	Certificate III in Stonemasonry, Bricklaying, Construction, or equivalent trade qualification
•	Minimum 5 years’ experience as a Stonemason within construction, landscaping, or masonry environments
•	Minimum 5 years’ experience interpreting technical drawings, specifications, and construction measurements for masonry works
•	At least 5 years’ experience constructing retaining walls, stone structures, and masonry installations across residential or commercial projects
•	At least 5 years’ experience operating masonry tools, polishing equipment, cutting machinery, and stone fabrication tools
•	At least 5 years’ experience constructing stone retaining walls, rock walls, garden walls, paving, steps and outdoor stone features
•	Minimum 5 years’ experience using stone cutting, grinding, drilling, shaping and finishing tools in a construction or landscaping environment
•	Strong knowledge of masonry construction methods, mortar application, and stone finishing techniques
•	Ability to read and interpret technical plans, site measurements, and installation specifications accurately
•	Strong understanding of workplace safety procedures, scaffolding requirements, and construction compliance standards
•	White Card required
•	Excavator and Skid Steer licences preferred
•	Ability to work outdoors, at heights, and across varying construction site environments
•	Strong work ethic, reliability, and ability to work independently or within construction teams
•	High attention to detail and commitment to workmanship quality

result.description: Rumdel Construction Pty Ltd  The Construction Supervisor is responsible for the on-site planning, coordination, direction and control of road rehabilitation and pavement construction works, including asphalt milling, in-situ pavement stabilisation, spray sealing and asphalt paving. Operating within Rumdel Construction’s civil delivery teams, the role ensures works are completed safely, on program, within budget and in accordance with contract specifications, Australian Standards and relevant Transport for NSW (TfNSW) and local government requirements.   Benefits  Salary plus 12% super. Company provided vehicle or a vehicle allowance.   Task & responsibilities   Site Planning & Works Coordination   - Plan, organise, direct and coordinate day-to-day road rehabilitation operations across milling, stabilisation, spray seal and asphalt paving activities.   - Interpret engineering drawings, pavement designs and specifications to set out works and confirm levels, depths and tolerances.   - Coordinate labour, plant, materials and subcontractors to maintain continuous, efficient production and meet project milestones.   - Develop and communicate daily work plans, shift schedules and traffic staging arrangements.   Technical & Quality Management   - Supervise asphalt milling to specified depth, profile and cross-fall, ensuring surface preparation meets design requirements.   - Oversee in-situ stabilisation works, including binder spread rates, mixing depth, moisture conditioning and compaction.   - Manage spray sealing operations, including binder and aggregate application rates, temperatures and sequencing.   - Control asphalt paving and compaction to achieve specified thickness, density, joint quality and ride characteristics.   - Verify conformance against Inspection and Test Plans (ITPs), TfNSW/MRTS specifications and approved hold and witness points.   Safety, Environment & Compliance   - Implement and enforce WHS requirements, Safe Work Method Statements (SWMS) and safe systems of work on all activities.   - Manage worksite traffic in accordance with approved Traffic Guidance Schemes and Traffic Management Plans.  - Conduct pre-start meetings, toolbox talks, hazard identification and risk assessments.  - Ensure environmental controls for dust, noise, spillage and water management are maintained.   Plant, Resources & Productivity   - Direct the operation and allocation of milling machines, stabilisers, pavers, rollers, sprayers and support plant.  - Monitor production rates, material usage and wastage to optimise cost and program outcomes.  - Coordinate deliveries of asphalt, aggregates and binders, and liaise with suppliers and the asphalt plant.   Communication, Reporting & Stakeholder Relations   - Maintain accurate site records, daily diaries, quality records and as-built information.  - Liaise with the Project Manager, clients, superintendents, council representatives and the community.  - Provide on-the-job direction, training and mentoring to operators, labourers and apprentices.  - Report progress, productivity, incidents and non-conformances to project management.   Qualification & experience   Skills & Competencies   - Strong practical knowledge of road rehabilitation and pavement construction methods (milling, in-situ stabilisation, spray seal and asphalt paving).  - Ability to interpret civil engineering drawings, pavement designs and technical specifications, including TfNSW and MRTS standards.  - Sound understanding of WHS legislation, traffic management and environmental compliance in civil works.  - Proven ability to plan, coordinate and supervise labour, plant and subcontractors to program.  - Strong leadership, communication, problem-solving and decision-making skills.  - Commercial awareness of production rates, materials control and cost management.   Qualifications & Accreditation   - Relevant qualification in Civil Construction or Construction Management, or equivalent demonstrated experience (minimum five years) in civil road construction supervision.  - Demonstrated experience supervising asphalt, in-situ stabilisation and sprayed sealing works.  - General Construction Induction Card (White Card).  - Traffic management accreditation (for example, Prepare a Work Zone Traffic Management Plan) desirable.  - Current driver licence; relevant plant and high-risk work licences desirable.  About Company     At Rumdel Construction, we deliver world-class civil, mining, and road infrastructure solutions with the hands-on expertise forged over decades. Proudly rooted in South Africa and now building across Australia, we combine global standards with local insight.    From remote mining access roads to major arterial highways, our team brings technical excellence, environmental responsibility, and a results-driven mindset to every project.
